messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "avoid injecting into damaged, tender, bruised, pitted, thickened, scaly, or scarred or hardened skin"
set: ["avoid injecting into damaged, tender, bruised, pitted, thickened, scaly, or scarred or hardened skin", "avoid broken or irritated skin", "avoid choking or gagging", "avoid scars or stretch marks", "avoid sunlight or tanning beds", "avoid driving or hazardous activity", "inject into the abdomen or thigh", "one or two months into treatment", "avoid certain liquid or injectable forms", "check medicine label before injecting", "do not inject into muscle or vein", "report severe pain, swelling, or skin changes", "may be injected into thigh or abdomen or have another person inject into back of upper arm", "avoid becoming overheated or dehydrated during exercise", "learn about foods to eat or avoid", "inform doctor about new or changing skin growth or non-healing sore"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
